# aether_organization_member (Resource)

A member of the provider's organization. The API creates the membership only. The address must already have an Aether login account (created through the portal invitation flow; aether-api #302), otherwise the member cannot sign in. Destroying the resource removes the membership and leaves the login account in place. There is no in-place update: changing `email` or `role` replaces the membership (it is removed, then created again with a new `id`). Do not set `create_before_destroy`: the new membership would be created while the old one still holds the address, which the API refuses (409). Removing or replacing the organization's last `owner` is refused, because the API has no such guard and nobody could change roles or delete the organization afterwards. The check reads the member's current role from the API and is serialised within a single run; the platform itself has no guard, so a concurrent removal in the portal or another run is not prevented. Transferring ownership takes two applies: add the new owner first, then demote or remove the old one in a second apply. Doing both in a single apply is refused by the last-owner guard or depends on the order in which Terraform happens to run the two changes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The address must already have an Aether login (portal invitation flow).
# Changing role REPLACES the membership; the last owner cannot be removed.
resource "aether_organization_member" "ops" {
  email = "ops@example.com"
  role  = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Login email address of the member. It must be lower-case: membership matches the login email exactly. Changing it replaces the membership.
- `role` (String) One of `owner`, `admin`, `member`, `viewer`. Changing it replaces the membership: a DELETE followed by a POST, which gives the membership a new `id`. The portal never offers `owner`. An `owner` can be demoted from Terraform like any other role; only the last owner is protected, and removing or replacing it is refused.

### Read-Only

- `accepted_at` (String) Time the invitation was accepted (RFC 3339). Always null for a membership created through the API.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the membership (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Membership UUID (not a user id). It changes when the membership is replaced.
- `invited_by` (String) UUID of the user who invited the member. Always null for a membership created through the API.
